bullets.text: Stream Premier League Live - **Fulham** faces **Manchester City** in a crucial match today.
Google Home Feature Removed - The ‘Call Home’ feature has been eliminated from the **Google Home** app.
Healthify's AI Assistant Upgrade - **Healthify** enhances its assistant **Ria** with real-time conversation capabilities.
AWS re:Invent Highlights - **AWS** showcases AI advancements and new customizable AI agents at its annual event.
Amazon's AI Factories - **Amazon** introduces on-premises **Nvidia** AI systems for corporate data sovereignty.
Kalshi's Massive Funding - **Kalshi** raises $1B, doubling its valuation to $11B in under two months.
Google's AI Mode Testing - **Google** tests merging AI Overviews with AI Mode for enhanced search experiences.
Indiegogo's New Crowdfunding - **Indiegogo** launches 'Express Crowdfunding' for quicker shipping during campaigns.
Discord's In-Game Purchases - **Discord** enables users to buy in-game items directly within the platform.
YouTube's Yearly Recap - **YouTube** launches its first-ever recap feature for users to revisit their watched videos.
